text:
Alice Nguyen: Heads up — need to provision a short-lived analyst lease for a partner SIEM export. Must be KMS-unwrapped, scrubbed, and TTLed to 48h. Who can approve and what's the template? cc @Sam Patel @Carmen Ortiz

Sam Patel: Can you paste the partner req and the justification? We need to ensure scope-limited ACL and masked PII.

Alice Nguyen: here's the snippet they sent: https://partner.example.com/export-req-2981. We only need session_id, event_type, timestamp, user_id (tokenized).

Carmen Ortiz: We should use the ephemeral export flow. sec-oncall will do unwrap via kms-proxy for a 2-hour window, then rotate key. Need ticket in #sec-requests with owner + retention expiry. Also require scrubbed regex patterns (no email, ip, full-uuids).

sec-oncall: Reminder: policy requires JIT unwrap approvals from at least one oncall + one security approver for external exports. For TTL <72h we allow 1 security approver + owner. Please attach the justification and intended consumer.

Alice Nguyen: Proposed steps: 1) Create ticket in #sec-requests with justification and consumer contact. 2) Create ephemeral SIEM export job with ttl=48h and ACL limited to partner principal. 3) Apply scrub rules and upload a 3-row sanitized sample for review. 4) Request KMS unwrap via kms-proxy for a 4-hour window (explicitly logged). 5) Post-handoff, capture audit events and rotate keys as needed.

Sam Patel: Add audit event names we must capture: `export.requested`, `export.unwrapped`, `export.sample_reviewed`, `export.completed`, `export.revoked`. Also: link to playbook https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ephemeral-exports (internal).

Carmen Ortiz: I can own scrub config. Please include the regex and an allowlist of fields to keep. Also confirm masking strategy for `user_id` (tokenize vs hash).

Alice Nguyen: Sample sanitized row: ```session_id: s_XXXX, event_type: login_failed, timestamp: 2026-03-20T18:02:00Z, user_id: u_YYYY```

infra-bot: deploy:created export-job-12345 by alice. TTL set to 48h. ETA: 2m

Sam Patel: Approving conditional on KMS key policy: no cross-account unwraps, unwraps must go through kms-proxy, and all unwrap events logged to audit with one-year retention. Carmen — once you validate scrub we'll approve.

Carmen Ortiz: Scrub looks OK on the sample. Quick QA pass complete. I'll attach the regex and sample diff to the ticket.

Alice Nguyen: Thanks all — creating #sec-requests ticket now (will include sample + regex + consumer OOO contact). Will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
